description: The figure presents two sets of bar charts comparing model performance scores on two benchmarks, MATH-500 (left group, panels a–c) and AIME24 (right group, panels d–f), with each panel showing a small set of categorical model variants on the horizontal axis and a numeric score on the vertical axis. In the MATH-500 group, each subplot uses a vertical value axis labeled by tick marks from about 65 to 100 on a linear scale with regularly spaced 5-point intervals, while the category axis is horizontal with three categories per panel: (a) shows categories “3B,” “unk,” and “405B,” with bars colored/hatched as Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (blue with diagonal hatching) at 78.2, GPT-4o (purple) at 74.6, and Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (green) at 71.4; (b) shows categories “1.5B,” “unk,” and “unk,” with TTS (red with diagonal hatching) at 91.6, o1-mini (pink) at 90.0, and o1-preview (brown) at 85.5; (c) shows categories “671B,” “7B,” and “unk,” with DeepSeek-R1 (tan) at 97.3, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (orange with diagonal hatching) at 95.2, and o1 (gray) at 94.8. In the AIME24 group, each subplot uses a vertical value axis on a linear scale from 0 to 90 with 10-point tick intervals, and the horizontal category axis again lists three categories per panel: (d) shows “3B,” “405B,” and “unk,” with Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (blue hatched) at 30.0, Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (green) at 23.3, and GPT-4o (purple) at 9.3; (e) shows “unk,” “1.5B,” and “unk,” with o1-mini (pink) at 63.6, TTS (red hatched) at 63.3, and o1-preview (brown) at 44.6; (f) shows “7B,” “671B,” and “unk,” with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (orange hatched) at 83.3, DeepSeek-R1 (tan) at 79.8, and o1 (gray) at 79.2. Across panels, bars are single-series (not stacked), colors and hatch patterns correspond to the legend at the top, numeric values are printed above each bar, and the category labels appear in the order shown (not explicitly indicated as sorted), with no additional visual emphasis beyond the consistent use of color/hatching and small model icons placed near the tops of bars.
